summary.en: Founded JFC. His background as a designer and educator shaped its street-fashion and participant-training model.
summary.zh-TW: 創辦 JFC；其設計師與教育工作者背景影響了街頭時裝形式與參與者培訓。

summary.en: Organizer lists him as President. He described the Dewi Bumi staging ahead of HEAL.
summary.zh-TW: 主辦方列為主席；曾在 HEAL 前說明《Dewi Bumi》的舞臺構想。

summary.en: Listed as JFC Chief Executive Officer in the organizer roster.
summary.zh-TW: 主辦方名冊列為 JFC 執行長。

summary.en: Listed as Chairman of JFC in the organizer roster.
summary.zh-TW: 主辦方名冊列為 JFC 理事長。

summary.en: Listed as Costume Director. This role does not establish individual costume authorship.
summary.zh-TW: 主辦方列為服裝總監；此職銜無法證明個別服裝由其設計。

summary.en: JFC lists the professional make-up artist among its ambassadors. Jember Regency named him among JFC contributors at the 2024 launch.
summary.zh-TW: 主辦方將這位專業彩妝師列為嘉年華大使；地方政府也在 2024 年主題發表時提到他的參與。

summary.en: Presented designs at the 2019 Grand Carnival in tribute to Dynand Fariz.
summary.zh-TW: 在 2019 年主遊行呈現設計，向 Dynand Fariz 致敬。

summary.en: Sang at the 2026 WACI closing on July 25.
summary.zh-TW: 於 2026 年 7 月 25 日 WACI 閉幕演唱。

summary.en: Presented a Raja Ampat-themed design at Artwear Carnival. This is an event-specific design credit.
summary.zh-TW: 於 Artwear Carnival 發表 Raja Ampat 主題設計；此為該場活動的作品署名。

summary.en: Modelled Delinda’s Raja Ampat-themed design at Artwear Carnival.
summary.zh-TW: 於 Artwear Carnival 展示 Delinda 的 Raja Ampat 主題設計。

summary.en: RRI reported Grand Carnival participation. Defile and Unity image attribution are unresolved.
summary.zh-TW: RRI 報導其參與主遊行；所屬分隊與 Unity 展圖關聯仍待查證。

summary.en: RRI reported Grand Carnival participation. Defile and Unity image attribution are unresolved.
summary.zh-TW: RRI 報導其參與主遊行；所屬分隊與 Unity 展圖關聯仍待查證。
